mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level relative to its 3-month moving average compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to future S&P 500 cash flows and generating positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS (relative to 3-month moving average) falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS is below its 3-month average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for three consecutive months, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases the discount rate for equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in private sector employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tight labor market that boosts corporate profit margins and consumer spending, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect between PAYEMS and UNRATE (measured by the product term) has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market recovery regime (HOUST > 1300), rising residential sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand that supports corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for RSAFS (conditional on HOUST > 1300) falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when RSAFS increases in the housing recovery regime.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output, which correlates with stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for INDPRO falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO increases.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1300 thousand units for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening housing market that reduces consumer confidence and corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1300 for 2 consecutive months, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% year-over-year), a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect between CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS (measured by the product term) has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 3.5% YoY and FEDFUNDS rises.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 5.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0% for 2 consecutive months, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.
